policy: Q4.3b drafts. Meanings come from a Claude session draft (source). An entry reaches the app only after a second model has cross-checked it (checkedBy) and, if the check disagreed (disputed), the owner has reviewed it (reviewed). The owner also reviews a random 10% sample (npm run glossary:sample) and the disputed entries (npm run glossary:disputed), then signs off by setting sampleApprovedBy; until then nothing ships. Learning words keep their own reviewed translations.
